sections.title: Section 87 - Deduction of Tax from Honorium of Members of parliament A person responsible for payment of any sum as honorarium to a Member of Parliame
sections.content_text: Section 87 - Deduction of Tax from Honorium of Members of parliament A person responsible for payment of any sum as honorarium to a Member of Parliament shall, when making such payment, deduct from the honorarium payable, the amount applicable to income-tax at the average rate of tax applicable to the estimated total honorarium of the recipient for that income year.
